verdict.rationale: vLLM is self-hostable: it installs with uv/pip, can be built from source, and ships an official Docker image that runs its OpenAI-compatible server on many hardware backends. Community users report running it as the foundation of their own serving stacks. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, and a detailed self-hosting operations guide (e.g. Kubernetes/production hardening).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
